resources.string: Sky Map varsler bare om sjeldne himmelhendelser, maksimalt én gang om dagen. Alt er slått av til du slår det på.

string.name: settings_shower_alerts
string.translation_description: Preference title: notify on the evening a meteor shower reaches its annual peak

string.name: settings_shower_alerts_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the meteor-shower notification preference

resources.string: Rundt et dusin i året, på kvelden for toppen

string.name: settings_tonight_digest
string.translation_description: Preference title: a single evening notification summarizing what\'s visible tonight

string.name: settings_tonight_digest_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the tonight-digest notification preference

resources.string: Ett sammendrag etter solnedgang, hoppes over på rolige netter

string.name: settings_notifications_blocked
string.translation_description: Warning row shown when the user enabled notifications in the app but blocked them at the system level

resources.string: Varsler er blokkert for Sky Map

string.name: settings_notifications_blocked_action
string.translation_description: Hint under the blocked-notifications warning; tapping opens the system settings page

resources.string: Trykk for å tillate dem i systeminnstillingene

string.name: diagnostics_share
string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the diagnostics screen button that emails these details to the developers

string.name: diagnostics_share_subject
string.translation_description: Subject line of the email a user sends from the diagnostics screen

string.name: diagnostics_report_header
string.translation_description: First line of the emailed diagnostics report, telling the user where to type their problem description. Keep it on one line.

resources.string: --- Sky Map-diagnose. Beskriv problemet over denne linjen. ---

string.name: diagnostics_section_recent_log
string.translation_description: Section heading, in the emailed diagnostics report only (not shown on screen), for the app's own recent log lines

string.name: diagnostics_section_graphics
string.translation_description: Section heading in the diagnostics screen for graphics/GPU information

string.name: diagnostics_gl_renderer
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the name of the graphics processor (GPU) drawing the sky

string.name: diagnostics_gl_limits
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for graphics hardware limits (maximum texture size, supported line widths and point sizes)

string.name: diagnostics_gl_limits_format
string.translation_description: Format for the GL limits row: maximum texture size in pixels, then the supported line width and point size ranges. \'tex\' abbreviates texture. %1$d is texture size, %2$s is the line width range, %3$s is the point size range.

string.name: diagnostics_gl_unavailable
string.translation_description: Value shown in the diagnostics Graphics rows before the sky map has drawn, when the graphics details are not known yet

string.name: diagnostics_sensor_rate_format
string.translation_description: Suffix appended to a diagnostics sensor row showing how often it is delivering events and how long ago the last one arrived. %1$.1f is a rate in events per second (Hz), %2$.1f is a number of seconds. Note the leading parenthesis and \'Hz\' abbreviates Hertz.

string.name: diagnostics_section_orientation_settings
string.translation_description: Section heading in the diagnostics screen for the user-adjustable settings that shape the sensor readings shown above it

string.name: diagnostics_gyro_mode
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for which sensor path supplies device orientation

string.name: diagnostics_gyro_fused
string.translation_description: Value shown for the gyro row when the fused rotation-vector sensor is in use

string.name: diagnostics_gyro_disabled
string.translation_description: Value shown for the gyro row when the rotation-vector sensor is skipped in favour of accelerometer plus compass

string.name: diagnostics_smoothing
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for whether orientation smoothing is on

string.name: diagnostics_steadiness
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the orientation smoothing filter's steadiness setting

string.name: diagnostics_ease_off
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the orientation smoothing filter's ease-off setting

string.name: diagnostics_reverse_magnetic_z
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for whether the magnetometer's Z axis is reversed

string.name: diagnostics_use_magnetic_correction_setting
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for whether magnetic declination correction is applied

string.name: diagnostics_view_direction_mode
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for which phone axis is treated as pointing at the sky

string.name: diagnostics_calibration_dialog
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for whether the automatic compass-calibration dialog is suppressed

string.name: diagnostics_calibration_dialog_suppressed
string.translation_description: Value shown for the calibration dialog row when the automatic dialog is suppressed

string.name: diagnostics_calibration_dialog_shown
string.translation_description: Value shown for the calibration dialog row when the automatic dialog is not suppressed

string.name: diagnostics_jitter_raw
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for how much the sensor-derived pointing wobbles before smoothing is applied

string.name: diagnostics_jitter_smoothed
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for how much the sensor-derived pointing wobbles after smoothing is applied

string.name: diagnostics_jitter_format
string.translation_description: Row value in the diagnostics screen showing the standard deviation of azimuth and altitude over a trailing window, in degrees. \'az\' abbreviates azimuth, \'alt\' abbreviates altitude, the sigma character denotes standard deviation. %1$.2f is the azimuth standard deviation in degrees, %2$.2f is the altitude standard deviation in degrees.

string.name: diagnostics_jitter_pending
string.translation_description: Value shown for the jitter rows before enough sensor samples have arrived to compute a standard deviation

string.name: diagnostics_location_unset
string.translation_description: Location status shown in diagnostics when no location has been set yet

string.name: diagnostics_location_hardware_unavailable
string.translation_description: Location status shown in diagnostics when the device has no usable location provider, whether because it lacks location hardware or none is enabled

string.name: diagnostics_alignment_adjustment
string.translation_description: Diagnostics row label for the manual sky-alignment correction the user set by dragging in through-camera mode.

string.name: diagnostics_east
string.translation_description: Compass direction shown for an eastward magnetic correction

string.name: diagnostics_west
string.translation_description: Compass direction shown for a westward magnetic correction

string.name: diagnostics_satellite_force_fetch
string.translation_description: Label on a debug-only button in the diagnostics screen that downloads satellite orbital data immediately

string.name: gallery_title
string.translation_description: Title of the screen showing a gallery of photographs of celestial objects. Not the user\'s own photos - these are catalog images from sources such as NASA and ESA.

string.name: gallery_back
string.translation_description: Content description for the back arrow leaving the gallery screen
